source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Colchicine is an antibacterial drug used to eradicate infection in a gouty joint.","B":"Colchicine is indicated only for acute treatment and has no role in gout-flare prophylaxis.","C":"Colchicine is indicated for both treatment of acute gout flares and prophylaxis of gout flares.","D":"Colchicine is a long-term urate-lowering drug whose main labeled purpose is to dissolve urate deposits."}}
source_row.rationale: Current FDA labeling states that colchicine is indicated for prophylaxis and treatment of acute gout flares. The prior item wording risked implying that colchicine has no preventive role.
